title: Huangqin-Huanglian Decoction Protects Liver against Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease in High Fat-diet Mice.
authors: Yang, Hongying; Wei, Dongyun; Zhang, Yao; Jian, Wenxuan
journal: Endocrine, metabolic & immune disorders drug targets
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方对非酒精性脂肪肝的保护作用，采用网络药理学和分子对接，但核心对象为药物-靶点而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) has the advantage of low toxicity of natural ingredients, multiple targets and effects, and low medication costs. It has unique advantages for metabolic and chronic diseases. Huangqin-Huanglian decoction (HQHLD) is composed of Scutellariae Radix, Coptidis Rhizoma, Rehmanniae Radix, and Gentianae Radix Et Rhozima; it has great potential for the treatment of NAFLD with the modern pharmacological research and TCM theory, but there is still a relative lack of research on the potential targets and pharmacological effects of HQHLD. METHODS: In this work, we have used network pharmacology to predict the targets and signaling pathways of HQHLD, and validated NAFLD-related targets using the HFD model in order to explore more therapeutic drugs and methods for NAFLD. We collected the HQHLD ingredients and NAFLD targets through TCMSP, ETCM, DisGeNET, HGMD, MalaCards, OMIM, and TTD, built ingredients-target networks by Cytoscape, and screened key ingredients in HQHLD. DAVID and Metascape databases were used for GO functional enrichment analysis and KEGG pathway enrichment analysis, respectively. Molecular docking of the key ingredients and key targets was performed by AutoDock. We verified the effect of HQHLD on high-fat diet (HFD) mice by measuring the weight, liver weight index, and the level of TG, TC, LDL-C, and HDLC. HE staining and oil-red staining were performed to detect the damage and fat accumulation in the liver. The changes in INSR, PPAR-alpha, PPAR-gamma, TNF-alpha, and caspase3 were experimented with WB. RESULTS: With the network pharmacology analysis, we found quercetin, baicalein, sitosterol, wogonin, oroxylin-A, glycyrrhizin, hydroberberine, berberine, sesamin, and carotene to be the main ingredients in HQHLD. According to KEGG pathway analysis, INSR, AKT, JNK1, PPAR-alpha, PPAR-gamma, and the other 16 targets are the main targets of HQHLD in the treatment of NAFLD. We took HFD mice as the in vivo model of NAFLD. Our results showed that HQHLD could reduce liver weight, and TG and LDL-C levels, and increase HDL-C level in serum. By HE and oil red staining, we found that HQHLD could protect the morphology of hepatocytes and reduce fat in the liver. We also found HQHLD to protect the liver by increasing the expression of INSR and PPAR-alpha, and reducing the expression of PPAR-gamma, TNF-alpha, and caspase3 in the liver. CONCLUSION: In conclusion, our study has firstly studied the main ingredients and key targets of HQHDL in treating NAFLD by network pharmacology analysis, and preliminarily confirmed that HQHLD could alleviate NAFLD in a multi-target way by lowering fatty acids, and decreasing insulin resistance, inflammation, and apoptosis in the liver.
abstract_zh: 背景：中药（TCM）具有天然成分毒性低、多靶点多效应、用药成本低的优势，对代谢性疾病和慢性疾病具有独特优势。黄芩-黄连汤（HQHLD）由黄芩、黄连、生地黄和龙胆草组成；结合现代药理学研究和中医理论，其在治疗非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）方面具有巨大潜力，但关于HQHLD的潜在靶点和药理作用的研究仍相对缺乏。方法：在本研究中，我们采用网络药理学方法预测HQHLD的靶点和信号通路，并利用高脂饮食（HFD）模型验证与NAFLD相关的靶点，以探索更多治疗NAFLD的药物和方法。我们通过TCMSP、ETCM、DisGeNET、HGMD、MalaCards、OMIM和TTD数据库收集HQHLD成分和NAFLD靶点，利用Cytoscape构建成分-靶点网络，并筛选HQHLD中的关键成分。分别使用DAVID和Metascape数据库进行GO功能富集分析和KEGG通路富集分析。通过AutoDock对关键成分和关键靶点进行分子对接。我们通过测量体重、肝脏重量指数以及TG、TC、LDL-C和HDL-C水平，验证了HQHLD对高脂饮食（HFD）小鼠的影响。采用HE染色和油红染色检测肝脏损伤和脂肪积累。通过Western blot（WB）实验检测INSR、PPAR-α、PPAR-γ、TNF-α和caspase3的变化。结果：通过网络药理学分析，我们发现槲皮素、黄芩素、谷甾醇、汉黄芩素、去甲汉黄芩素、甘草酸、氢化小檗碱、小檗碱、芝麻素和胡萝卜素是HQHLD的主要成分。根据KEGG通路分析，INSR、AKT、JNK1、PPAR-α、PPAR-γ及其他16个靶点是HQHLD治疗NAFLD的主要靶点。我们以HFD小鼠作为NAFLD的体内模型。结果表明，HQHLD能降低肝脏重量、血清中TG和LDL-C水平，并增加HDL-C水平。通过HE和油红染色，我们发现HQHLD能保护肝细胞形态并减少肝脏脂肪。我们还发现HQHLD通过增加肝脏中INSR和PPAR-α的表达，并降低PPAR-γ、TNF-α和caspase3的表达来保护肝脏。结论：总之，我们的研究首次通过网络药理学分析研究了HQHLD治疗NAFLD的主要成分和关键靶点，并初步证实HQHLD通过降低脂肪酸、减少胰岛素抵抗、炎症和肝脏凋亡，以多靶点方式缓解NAFLD。
